name: Canva
question: What is Canva?
title: What is Canva design studio? | BrandBizkit
description:
Understanding the basics of Canva design studio. What it is, what it can do, and how it works.
Explore the revolutionary AI technology that is built into Canva and how it can transform your regular designs into professional, production-ready designs.
paragraphs: Canva is a free-to-use online graphic design tool that makes it easy to create beautiful designs for work, school, and life. With a user-friendly interface and thousands of templates, anyone can become a designer.

Founded in 2012, Canva has grown to become one of the world's leading design platforms, used by millions of people and businesses to create everything from social media posts to presentations, posters, videos, and more.
Whether you're a complete beginner or a design professional, Canva provides the tools and resources you need to bring your ideas to life.

We can help you get started using Canva and other related AI design tools. If you already are a user of Canva we can also help you level up your game, teach you new ways of using AI and enhance your output and productivity with super efficient prompts. capabilities.heading: What Can Canva Do?
capabilities.sub: A quick look at what's actually in Canva today — this gets re-checked regularly as new Magic Studio features ship.

items.title: Templates & Drag-and-Drop Design
items.text: Thousands of ready-made templates for social posts, presentations, posters and more — no design experience required to get something polished fast.

items.title: Magic Design
items.text: Describe what you need or upload a photo, and Canva generates full layout options built around it in seconds.

items.title: Dream Lab
items.text: Canva's text-to-image generator — type a prompt, pick a style, and drop the result straight into your design without leaving the workspace.

items.title: Magic Write
items.text: AI copywriting built directly into every text box, for headlines, captions and body copy you can refine in place.

items.title: Magic Eraser & Expand
items.text: Remove unwanted objects from a photo or extend it beyond its original borders, all inside the same editor.

items.title: Brand Kit
items.text: Save your logos, fonts and colors once so every new design — yours or a teammate's — stays on-brand automatically.
